All THREE topology gaps fixed with a real control-edge rewiring, plus a fourth found by the same walk.

MECHANISM: _lower_construct_item's single 'primary_node' (which served as BOTH the incoming-edge target and the outgoing-edge source) is split into an ENTRY node and a list of (from_node, from_branch) EXITS. to_agent_spec chains every exit of item N to the entry of item N+1, and terminates every exit of the last item at the EndNode.

1. Operator body bypass -- the composite now keeps the ARM's entry (the body it guards) and appends the gate to the arm's EXITS, mirroring _wiring._add_operator_check's 'node -> check'. Pre-fix the body had NO inbound edge at all: unreachable.
2. Pause node dead end -- the composite exits on BOTH (check, DEFAULT_BRANCH) and (pause, None), reconverging on the successor. That IS the runtime resume path (the interrupt fires inside the check node, so the human's answer resumes there and falls through), not an invented one.
3. Fused Each x Oracle variants -- fixed at the root, in _lower_oracle: the variants are now CHAINED (variant_0 -> ... -> variant_n-1 -> merge) instead of all pointing at the merge, so each has an inbound edge. This fixes the un-fused top-level ORACLE identically (same defect, same shared function). Chain not ParallelFlowNode because pyagentspec forbids two subflows exposing the same output title, which N Oracle variants do by construction; the variants are independent, so sequential is a valid topological order.
4. (found by the reachability test) LOOP was exported as a while-do -- entered at the check -- while neograph's Loop is a DO-while. Now entered at the BODY and exited via the check's 'done' branch.
